editorial: You feel the choking pressure of a world where vengeance is the only currency. It treats the underworld like an abyss, using oppressive jazz scores to turn every corridor into a stage of claustrophobia. Joaquin Phoenix carries every scene with almost no dialogue, letting his raw silence scream louder than any gunfire. A brief stumble in pacing during the final act leaves the climax feeling slightly rushed, but the emotional payoff remains all the more potent. You’re at home if you thrive on tense, character‑driven crime stories that push the line between loyalty and brutality.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of psychological thrillers who enjoy non-linear storytelling.
